comments.value:
Would love to see changes to the loading screen. 
**Some thoughts:**
Tip system *can* be good for new players. I remember finding them helpful personally. 
- After a certain playtime / account level, etc, they could either automatically go away or be allowed to be toggled off. 
The loading screen is a good oppourtunity to relay information - perhaps instead of the old info tips, they could be toggled out for news / updates, similar to what's in the new menu? (potentially frees up menu space)
**Other (simpler, in theory) ideas:**
- HSV sliders / other tweaks for loading enviro
- Alternate audio / music choices
- Calibration mirror, avatar switch, etc. 
- Screenshot display
**More complex ideas (in theory):**
- World preloading so less time in loading screen to begin with
- custom (cached) homeworld as loading environment
- Visual transition in / out of worlds
I hope to see the old loading screen get implemented like this mod did: https://github.com/Grummus/BetterLoadingScreen

> Information of the map you joining, Author, Description of the map as it's on VRChat website, Number of the instance.

The reason I even logged into feedback.vrchat.com today. Wanted to post this feature request. Hss been bugging me for months.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: Any progressing news on the features? I and a number of friends listen to our own music, and would love to lower, preferably turn off, the loading screen music. If anything, change it from menu sounds to world sounds, as it makes more sense.

Bump for a toggle to disable music while loading.

If it technically possible to add stuff to do while in loading, it would be great. But I'm note sure it is possible.

details:
Hello, I have made 2 canny about it but as many other it get lost in the huge ocean of requests, there is many similar that has been written along the time, can we merge them into 1 big canny and get all the votes together?

**--------------------------------------------------------------------**
**MENU**
° OPTION: Offer alternative to remove TIPs of VRChat
° SLIDER to Lower the audio of Loading screen, people listen to music and it cant be muted
° Possibility to have some "NEWS" or "COMMUNITIES ACTIVITIES" Options to turn off/on in case we want to get informed of events, it's the perfect time to check them while you wait.

**IDEAS**
° Give the option to see yourself and maybe a mirror so you can.. calibrate your avatar meanwhile or take some photos of you?
° Possibility to change the loading map to custom made one,  you can set it same as home, or at least give the change to have the one we have but been able to change the Environment Skybox to something darker,  having a blast light green each time you change world get your eyes tired and mostly if you are parting, you could even have a storytime picture floating with random pictures you took along the time.
° Chance to change to old classic VRChat loading screen or at least make it so it be included in the option described above with it's classic music
° If the mirror Idea is not your taste and you need to wait for maps that have 400mb, a mini game could be also an option, shooting plates? Throwing objects? Arrow game? Tic Tac Toe with a AI anime waifu? Something.
° Add the option to change your status in the meantime
° Information of the map you joining, Author, Description of the map as it's on VRChat website, Number of the instance.

If in a VRChat Dev blog says that "We are thinking on implementing a preloading world" that make this all canny make no sense please comment it below

** OR **
° Preload worlds and all above make no sense since there wont be a loading screen.
